title: Version 2.0.0 Release
summary: Major release with new graph-based test editor, real-time device streaming via WebRTC, and natural language test instructions.
body_markdown:
# What’s New in v2.0.0


This major release brings a completely redesigned test editor and real-time device streaming.


## New Features


- **New graph-based test editor with drag-and-drop** - Create tests visually with our new node-based editor
- **Real-time device streaming via WebRTC** - Watch your tests execute live
- **Natural language test instructions** - Write test instructions in plain English


## Bug Fixes


- Improved element detection accuracy
- Fixed iOS simulator connection issues


## Breaking Changes


- Updated API response format for test results


---


## New Graph Editor


Create tests visually with our new node-based editor. Drag and drop instructions, validations, and decision nodes to build complex test flows.


## Real-Time Streaming


Watch your tests execute live with WebRTC streaming. No more waiting for videos to upload.


## Natural Language


Write test instructions in plain English. Our AI understands what you mean and executes the right actions.
